brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: MISSION_EXECUTION_CONFIRMATION

OBJECTIVE:
Confirm whether the Runtime will autonomously execute the complete mission that has been assigned to it.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Analyze the current Runtime execution state.
- Consider the assigned mission in its entirety, including all approved phases, dependencies, rules and constraints already provided.
- Confirm whether the Runtime will continue executing the mission autonomously without requiring additional human commands.
- If execution will stop before mission completion, explain the exact reason and identify the blocking mechanism.
- If execution will continue autonomously, explain which Runtime component is responsible for continuing the execution.
- State whether the Runtime can safely be left running unattended on the VPS until the assigned mission is complete (or until a genuine blocking condition requiring human intervention occurs).
- Do not modify any file.
- Do not implement any change.
- Produce only one final verdict:
  MISSION_AUTONOMY_CONFIRMED
  or
  MISSION_AUTONOMY_NOT_CONFIRMED
- Justify the verdict with technical evidence.
